elements.__comment: Face-parallel plane. Drawn for facing=north: the log is to the south and the stem base sits on the face of its 8-pixel (chorus-sized) core, 4 pixels into the log's block; the plane leans out (north) and up.
Perpendicular plane through the stem, tilted the same way. The tilt is in this plane, so a flat stem base would show as a slant; #side has the stem bent so it runs straight into the log.
